en.topic_title: Grandmother, domestic worker arrested for suspected child neglect after viral videos spark investigation

zh.topic_title: Grandmother, domestic worker arrested for suspected child neglect after viral videos spark investigation

en.topic_title: Grandmother, domestic worker arrested for suspected child neglect after viral videos spark investigation
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong police have arrested a 61-year-old woman and a domestic worker over suspected child neglect after video clips of a girl crying for help went viral on social media.



A screenshot of a viral video showing a girl calling for help after saying she got into an argument with her family. Photo: Screenshot, via Threads.



Police said on Friday they were investigating the suspected maltreatment of an 11-year-old girl by her family, following a referral from the Social Welfare Department.
